X-Frame-Options.description: Missing X-Frame-Options header. Recommended: DENY or SAMEORIGIN

X-XSS-Protection.purpose: Legacy XSS protection (deprecated but still useful)

Strict-Transport-Security.description: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header. Recommended: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

Content-Security-Policy.purpose: Prevents XSS and data injection attacks

Referrer-Policy.description: Missing Referrer-Policy header. Recommended: no-referrer or strict-origin-when-cross-origin
